parameters.query:
SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.owner_id,
    o.opportunity_name,
    o.stage,
    o.estimated_value_idr,
    o.expected_close_date,
    o.target_deployment_date,
    o.customer_requirements_json,
    o.current_discount_pct,
    o.requested_discount_pct,
    o.outstanding_questions_json,

    osl.solution_line_id,
    osl.product_id,
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    p.product_role,
    p.commercial_status,
    osl.quantity,
    osl.estimated_unit_price_idr

FROM opportunities o

LEFT JOIN opportunity_solution_lines osl
    ON osl.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id

LEFT JOIN products p
    ON p.product_id = osl.product_id

WHERE o.opportunity_id = $1

ORDER BY osl.solution_line_id ASC;
